decisions.statement: An account reaches a person through the account that person states.
A contributor reaches a person through the contributor that person names.
Whoever a caller is, is one contributor or one account.
A contributor named without a page type is the contributor of that slug.
A contributor named under another page type is nobody.
A contributor no person names is nobody.
A contributor two people name is read to neither person.
The person pages are asked of the pages system service rather than opened.
An account no person states is nobody.
An account stating nothing is nobody.
An account two people state is read to neither person.
A refusal says whether the pages went unread or named nobody.
Nothing here sets up a person who has no page.
Nothing here decides a person's access.

definition: the person a caller signing in represents
